title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Base Surcharge per Container by Container Size
content:
## Clause

The hazardous-cargo surcharge of Dangerous Goods Acceptance starts from a base amount per container, and which base applies depends on the container type code shown on the booking that carries the goods. The 20-foot base applies when that code is one of the 20-foot types — 20DV, 20RF, 20OT, 20FR or 20TK. Every other type, which is to say every 40-foot and 45-foot type, takes the 40-foot base.

## Base per container (USD)

| Category | 20-foot base | 40-foot and 45-foot base |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 60.00 | 90.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 150.00 | 225.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 250.00 | 375.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 375.00 | 560.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 350.00 | 525.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 850.00 | 1275.00 |

## Quick classification of type codes

| Code on the booking | Base used |
|---|---|
| 20DV, 20RF, 20OT, 20FR, 20TK | 20-foot base |
| 40DV, 40HC, 40RH, 40OT, 40FR, 45HC | 40-foot base |

## Cases

- AHL DG Class 9 Standard goods on a booking coded 40HC: the base is 225.00 per container.
- AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers goods on a booking coded 20TK: the base is 375.00 per container.

## Point of judgement

**Is the type taken from the acceptance or from the booking?** From the booking carrying the goods.
